description: notion-sync hit a problem on its hourly pass; the runbook docs/runbooks/notion-sync.md names the fix.
notion-sync's pass found something off with the data itself, not a hard failure; check the sync log for which page or database.
Atlas found a source it could not read or a note it could not derive; the SOMA/venture narrative may be stale until fixed.
An LLM key is approaching or past its monthly budget; when the cap is crossed that consumer's model calls are refused until the budget is raised.
The spine noticed a gap in its own configuration; open the Signals pages in the console to fix it.
A monitored host or endpoint stopped responding to Uptime Kuma; the card turns green in place when the same monitor comes back.
A scheduled job did not check in to healthchecks.io within its grace period, so it has either not run or not finished.
A Cloud Build pipeline failed, so whatever it was going to deploy is not deployed; the card turns green when that same pipeline next succeeds.
